# Vendored public dependencies

`xlsx-0.20.3.tgz` is the official SheetJS Community Edition distribution from
[the SheetJS CDN](https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/xlsx-0.20.3.tgz).
It is installed from this local archive and bundled into the document parser
worker. Its Apache-2.0 license is included in the archive and reproduced through
the project's third-party notices.
